audit_metadata.phase: PHASE 9A.0: PHASE 8B.9 EVIDENCE INTEGRITY & EXPERIMENT READINESS AUDIT
audit_metadata.verdict_rationale: Underlying trial evidence reconciles with zero mathematical discrepancies (147/147 valid attempts, 72 correct, E2E accuracy 48.98%, Accepted accuracy 61.54%). However, experimental condition confounding is severe (lighting, distance, and tempo were bundled in 3 deterministic profiles rather than orthogonally varied). The benchmark is fully usable for class-level error isolation and architecture comparison, but single-variable environmental causality cannot be claimed without factorial re-testing.

confounded_triplets: Attempt 1: Normal Indoor (300-500 lux) == Standard (~1.0m) == Normal Tempo (1.5-2.5s) == Centered
Attempt 2: Low Ambient (<100 lux) == Close (~0.5m) == Fast / Quick (<1.0s) == Slightly Off-Center
Attempt 3: Direct / Harsh Lighting == Far (~1.5m) == Sustained Hold (>3.0s) == Centered

hand_tracking_definition_clarification.finding: The reported '0 hand-tracking failures' signifies at-least-one-hand detection. MediaPipe suffered 100% secondary hand tracking loss on two-hand occlusion signs (friend, work, umbrella), causing dual presence collapse to 5-17%.
